text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Probably thanks to the hammock I've been using.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The size is just right, and it feels like it gently
wraps around you when you sleep, I suppose?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
When I saw it in the shop, it just clicked, like 'This is it!'
And it was just as good as I thought!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.'s intuition is as sharp as ever.
Thanks to that, it seems my fatigue has completely vanished!
